title_zh: 按材料分开战争爆发与战后重建的经历

scenario.label_zh: 按材料分开战争爆发与战后重建的经历
scenario.goal_zh: 核对口述史中两次迁居属于不同时期，并约定在时间线上分开标注

context_zh: 两位成人学员根据教师提供的虚构口述史制作时间线，不声称讲述真实历史人物。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I put the family’s move beside the outbreak of war, but the next paragraph describes postwar rebuilding. Have I mixed two events together?

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: Yes. The interview says they left the village when war began, then moved back to the city after it ended.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: So the first move was away from the fighting, and the second was part of starting again afterward.

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: That’s how the speaker describes it. We should keep those two reasons and periods separate.

sentences.speaker: Nell
sentences.text: I’ll put them on different lines and use the dates given in the interview.

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: Good. Then readers won’t mistake the return for the original departure.
